actual_scope: An exact eight-call scaling family passes all rational rank cuts, determinant equality and every dyadic nonzero-label counting cut through any prescribed finite order, but a ternary character excludes every scalar order and any finite restored dirty-role count. One fixed diagonal scalar word realizes each covered quotient H/(4^s H), while no full-H word can realize the target.
scope_change_reason: Take the concrete unequal-class pre-search handoff in pending PR2938 rather than reconstruct an already-covered larger-register census. The new object is a separating candidate and the missing screening implication, not a new operation alphabet. An initial witness also failed an existing C4 cut. Scaling A1 to 4^s E11, with a certified 3E11 relation, yields the stronger finite-dyadic separation without expanding a construction search.
bottleneck_link: Rational and binary screening can admit impossible candidates before expensive scalar-word searches. An exact additional rejection saves that search without implying a native supplier or kappa gain.
stop_rule: Stop after one exact separating instance, a written necessary-cut proof, registered replay, meaningful semantic controls and an independent internal review. No alphabet expansion or scalar-word search.
evidence: PROOF.md uniform family argument; fixed s=1 EXAMPLE.json and two-way LATTICE.json; RESULT.json; verify.py and seven behavioral test groups. Checks include 28 independent six-frame subsets, 64 binary/4096 order-four/729 ternary characters, 120 projectors, 16 formula cases and independent proof review. Four actual implementation mutants reject, including a wrong projected-role assignment; the same 16 family cases check coefficientwise quotient endpoints.
